name: Jack the Reapercorn

name: Playful Puppet Unicorn

name: Sweet Old Ladycorn

name: Unicorn Slasher
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may discard a card, then remove a card in any player's Stable from the game.

name: Vengeful Unicorn

name: Winged Horrorcorn
description: If this card is sacrificed or destroyed, you may look at another player's hand. Choose a card and add it to your hand.

name: Heeeeere's Stabby
description: Remove a card in any player's Stable from the game.

name: Possession
description: Discard a card, then steal a card.

name: Reanimation
description: Bring a Basic Unicorn card from the discard pile into your Stable, then DRAW a card.

name: Supernatural Selection
description: Choose any player. Destroy all Basic Unicorn cards in that player's Stable.

name: The Cornjuring
description: Search the deck for a Nightmare Downgrade card and bring it into any player's Stable, then shuffle the deck.

name: Nightmare Buried Alive
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, sacrifice a Unicorn card. If you have no Unicorn cards in your Stable, return this card to your hand.

name: Nightmare Currently Indisposed
description: When this card enters your Stable, sacrifice a Unicorn card. You cannot win the game if this card is in your Stable.

name: Nightmare Existential Dread
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, steal a Downgrade card.

name: Nightmare Exorcise Regimen
description: When this card enters your Stable, discard your hand, then draw a card. Your hand limit is reduced by 3 cards.

name: Ghost Guide
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may DRAW a card and reveal it. If it is an Upgrade or Downgrade card, bring it into your Stable.

name: Magic Elexir
description: If a card in your Stable would be sacrificed or destroyed, you may discard a card instead.

name: Paranormal Affection
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may DRAW 2 cards. Upgrade cards in your Stable cannot be destroyed.

name: Poltergeist Swipe
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may skip your draw phase. If you do, pull a card at random from another player's hand.

name: Saved by the Sigil
description: Downgrade cards cannot enter your Stable. This card cannot be sacrificed or destroyed.

name: Strange Craft Project
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may discard 3 cards, then remove a card in any player's Stable from the game.

name: Hex Neigh
description: Play this card when any other player tries to play a card. Stop their card from being played and remove it from the game.
